desc: Derive the reduction to half-sum values for even segments and the odd-N split over odd original indices.
Implement the complete Python solution using two heaps to compute even-prefix and even-suffix half-sum tables in O(N log N).
Combine prefix and suffix tables correctly for odd N and handle even N directly.
Run sample tests and edge cases such as N=2, all equal values, strictly increasing/decreasing arrays, and maximum constraints; fix any failures.
If the two-heap implementation has correctness or performance issues, switch to a coordinate-compressed Fenwick-tree approach for sum-of-smallest-k queries.
